# Antigravity Project Radar **简体中文** · [English](README.en.md) 轻量、无感融合的 Antigravity 独立插件：在左侧 `Projects` 列表折叠状态下，直接于行尾展示各项目的并行任务实时状态（运行中 / 待确认 / 未读刚完成），配合顶部跨项目汇总胶囊与悬停直达浮层，告别频繁展开目录找任务。 [MIT License](LICENSE) · 版本 `v1.0.5` · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md)
--- ## 界面预览（浅色 / 深色主题） ### 1. 左侧 `Projects` 行尾状态徽标 & 顶部全局汇总胶囊 所有项目行状态徽标**固定锚定在最右侧**（与会话行蓝点垂直对齐），无活跃或未读任务的项目保持空白不打扰；悬停项目行时，原生 `⋮` 与 `+` 操作按钮会自动左移让位，徽标不会在鼠标下移动： | 浅色主题 (Light) | 深色主题 (Dark) | | --- | --- | | ![侧栏行尾状态徽标（浅色）](assets/screenshot-sidebar-light.png) | ![侧栏行尾状态徽标（深色）](assets/screenshot-sidebar-dark.png) | ### 2. 单项目任务浮层（无需展开即可预览与跳转） 悬停或点击任意项目的状态徽标，即可查看该项目下正在运行（含运行时长与子任务数）、等待确认以及刚完成未读的会话列表；点击任一项通过宿主原生 TanStack Router 无刷新直达对应会话，也可单条忽略或一键「清除已读」： | 浅色主题 (Light) | 深色主题 (Dark) | | --- | --- | | ![单项目任务浮层（浅色）](assets/screenshot-project-popover-light.png) | ![单项目任务浮层（深色）](assets/screenshot-project-popover-dark.png) | ### 3. 跨项目并行总览浮层（滚出可视区也能掌握全局） 当工作区项目较多、部分项目滚出左侧可视区外时，点击或悬停 `Projects` 标题栏右侧的全局汇总胶囊，即可按项目分组浏览全部活跃与未读完成任务： | 浅色主题 (Light) | 深色主题 (Dark) | | --- | --- | | ![跨项目任务总览（浅色）](assets/screenshot-global-popover-light.png) | ![跨项目任务总览（深色）](assets/screenshot-global-popover-dark.png) | --- ## 状态徽标说明 | 状态 | 样式 | 触发与消退规则 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **运行中** | 蓝色旋转指示器 + 数量 | 存在 `RUNNING` 会话或活跃子 Agent（子任务数自动向根会话收敛） | | **待确认 / 异常** | 琥珀色 / 红色圆点 + 数量 | 会话等待人工审批确认（`WAITING`）或非正常结束 | | **刚完成（未读）** | 绿色对勾 `✓` + 数量 | 仅当任务从「运行中 / 待确认」跃迁为完成时记为未读；**点进该会话或宿主侧查看后自动消退**（主动取消不触发；手动「清除已读」仅收起雷达提醒，保留宿主原生未读蓝点） | --- ## 核心特性 - **固定最右侧 + 悬停避让**：状态徽标始终固定在项目行最右侧不跳动，悬停行时原生 `⋮` / `+` 自动向左平滑滑出到徽标左侧。 - **零刷新 SPA 直达**：通过复用侧栏链接或宿主 React Fiber 中的 TanStack Router 直接执行 `navigate()`，点击卡片即刻切换会话，不触发整页重新加载。 - **精准项目归属 & 子任务收敛**：基于 `GetAllCascadeTrajectories` 的 `workspaces[].workspaceFolderAbsoluteUri`（支持中文路径 URI 解码）与 `repository.computedName` 匹配项目，并将子 Agent 活动归并到主会话展示。 - **双向已读同步 & 持久化**：未读状态持久化至本地 `radar-state.json`（24 小时自动清理）；在 Antigravity 原生侧栏直接打开会话后，依据 `annotations.lastUserViewTime` 自动同步消除插件 `✓` 徽标。 - **宿主主题与字体自适应**：自动继承 `document.body` 字体设置及宿主 `--sidebar` / `--card` / `--card-border` / `--primary` 等颜色变量，完美融合浅色、深色与自定义主题。 - **独立双插件无冲突隔离**：采用独立 CDP 通道（`__agRadarRuntimeCallV1`）与 `window.__agRadar*` 命名空间，与 `antigravity-context` 并行运行互不干扰。 --- ## 安装与本地测试 将本仓库克隆到 Antigravity 的插件目录（目录名统一为 `antigravity-project-radar`）： ```bash git clone https://github.com/1swei/antigravity-project-radar.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-project-radar ``` Windows PowerShell： ```powershell git clone https://github.com/1swei/antigravity-project-radar.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-project-radar" ``` 克隆完成后，在 Antigravity 的 **Customizations → Plugins** 中启用 **Antigravity Project Radar**（或重新加载窗口）即可生效。 本地语法校验与单元测试（需要 Node.js >= 20）： ```powershell cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-project-radar" Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Include *.mjs,*.cjs | ForEach-Object { node --check $_.FullName } node --test sidecars/panel/tests/*.test.mjs ``` --- ## 开源协议 基于 [MIT License](LICENSE) 开源，完整变更记录见 [更新日志 (中文)](CHANGELOG.md) · [Changelog (English)](CHANGELOG.en.md)。

# Antigravity Project Radar [简体中文](README.md) · **English** A lightweight standalone plugin for Antigravity 2.0 that surfaces live parallel task status (**running / waiting / unread completed**) directly on collapsed **Projects** rows, with a global summary pill and hover-to-jump popovers. [MIT License](LICENSE) · Version `v1.0.5` · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.en.md)
--- ## Preview (Light / Dark) ### 1. Stationary Right-Side Project Badges & Global Summary Pill Status pills stay anchored to the far right edge of each Project row. Projects with no active or unread tasks stay clean; hovering a row smoothly shifts native `⋮` and `+` actions to the left of the badge without moving the badge under your cursor: | Light Theme | Dark Theme | | --- | --- | | ![Sidebar badges (Light)](assets/screenshot-sidebar-light.png) | ![Sidebar badges (Dark)](assets/screenshot-sidebar-dark.png) | ### 2. Per-Project Task Popover Hover or click any project badge to inspect active durations, subagent counts, and newly completed tasks without expanding the folder tree. Click any row for instant zero-reload navigation, or dismiss/clear unread completions: | Light Theme | Dark Theme | | --- | --- | | ![Project popover (Light)](assets/screenshot-project-popover-light.png) | ![Project popover (Dark)](assets/screenshot-project-popover-dark.png) | ### 3. Cross-Project Global Radar Popover Hover or click the summary pill next to **Projects** to view all active and unread-completed tasks across every project — even those scrolled out of view: | Light Theme | Dark Theme | | --- | --- | | ![Global popover (Light)](assets/screenshot-global-popover-light.png) | ![Global popover (Dark)](assets/screenshot-global-popover-dark.png) | --- ## Features - **Stationary Right-Aligned Badges**: Pinned at the far right edge of each project row; native `⋮` / `+` buttons slide left on hover (`[⋮] [+] [badge]`). - **Zero-Reload SPA Navigation**: Reuses mounted sidebar links or invokes the host TanStack Router (`router.navigate`) directly from the React fiber tree. - **Transition-Based Unread Tracking**: Only marks conversations as newly done (`✓`) when observed transitioning from active/waiting to settled (ignoring active view and user cancellations), with `lastUserViewTime` reverse-sync and atomic `radar-state.json` persistence. - **Native Theme & Font Adaptation**: Inherits `document.body` font family and composited host CSS tokens (`--sidebar`, `--card`, `--card-border`, `--primary`, `--success`, `--warning`, `--error`). - **Isolated Runtime**: Runs via dedicated CDP binding `__agRadarRuntimeCallV1` and `window.__agRadar*` namespace, coexisting cleanly alongside `antigravity-context`. --- ## Installation & Verification Clone this repository into Antigravity's plugins directory (`antigravity-project-radar`): ```bash git clone https://github.com/1swei/antigravity-project-radar.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-project-radar ``` Windows PowerShell: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/1swei/antigravity-project-radar.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-project-radar" ``` Enable **Antigravity Project Radar** under **Customizations → Plugins** (or reload the window) to activate. Local syntax & unit tests (requires Node.js >= 20): ```bash node --check sidecars/panel/main.mjs node --test sidecars/panel/tests/*.test.mjs ``` Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). See [Changelog (English)](CHANGELOG.en.md) · [更新日志 (中文)](CHANGELOG.md).
